decisions.reason: As a door lever handle family in the firm's core range, it fits the broad long-life portfolio that architects and builders expect, so it is more likely to be retained than withdrawn.
This design-oriented door handle remains close to the firm's established strengths in ergonomic and aesthetic fittings, although single designs are somewhat easier to rationalize than full families.

The electronic access system supports the firm's stated move toward digital building organization and differentiated system solutions, so management would more likely continue developing it than take it off the market.
